latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor India — first public release:

- Launches cloud-powered AI video editor focused on Indian social media workflows.
- Upload and edit MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automatic setup with anonymous or token-based authentication (100 free credits for new users).
- Supports Hindi captions, aspect ratio changes, text overlays, audio tracks, and quick export to 1080p MP4.
- Clear user guidance on uploading, editing, session handling, and common errors.
- Seamless 1–2 minute processing on cloud GPUs, optimized for Indian creators.
